datasets.label: Drosophila melanogaster RNA-seq read set (SRR1509507, SRR14197369, SRR14404397)
datasets.description: Three paired-end Drosophila melanogaster RNA-seq read sets consumed through params.reads by the Salmon RS2 workflow.
datasets.storage_location: FONDA Kubernetes persistent storage: /workspace/data/reads (one _1.fastq.gz and one _2.fastq.gz file per accession)
datasets.access_statement: The public FASTQ files were resolved through the ENA Portal API and downloaded resumably from ENA. SHA-256 checksums of the exact published example inputs are included with this profile.

datasets.label: Drosophila melanogaster reference genome, annotation and cDNA (Ensembl BDGP6.32, release 106)
datasets.description: The genome FASTA and cDNA FASTA used to build the decoy-aware Salmon index, plus the GTF and cDNA inputs used for strandedness checking.
datasets.storage_location: FONDA Kubernetes persistent storage: /workspace/data/reference (genome FASTA, cDNA FASTA and GTF stored uncompressed)
datasets.access_statement: Assembly BDGP6.32 and Ensembl release 106 are pinned by the Salmon RS2 execution configuration. SHA-256 checksums of the exact published example inputs are included with this profile.
